title: Writing Exam (2 tasks)
writingModel:
Dear Aizhan,

I hope you are well! I wanted to write to you about my English course at WKU, which I have been studying for nine months now.

When I started the course, I could only say "Hello" and "Thank you." Now I can write emails like this one, hold conversations, and even understand English films without too much difficulty. I have learned grammar structures that I use every day — like conditionals ("If I study hard, I will improve"), passive voice ("The exam was written last week"), and relative clauses ("She is a teacher who truly inspires me").

The course has been challenging, but I never gave up. If you are thinking about studying English, I strongly recommend it. It is a language that opens doors to the whole world.

Write back when you can!

Best wishes,
Kamila
TASK 2 — Film or Book Review (120 words)
'October Sky' is an inspiring film that is based on a true story. It tells the story of Homer Hickam, a teenager who grows up in a coal-mining town and dreams of becoming a rocket scientist.

The film, which was directed by Joe Johnston, is set in 1957. What I love most about it is the theme of believing in yourself even when others doubt you. Homer is a character who never gives up, no matter how many obstacles he faces.
The performances are outstanding, the soundtrack is emotional, and the ending left me feeling hopeful. I highly recommend this film to anyone who has ever had a dream that seemed impossible.
